# SonarQube Dashboard Builder Skill

> **Category:** Tech Skills > QA > SonarQube

## Overview

Creates SonarQube dashboards and portfolios for code quality visibility across projects with custom metrics and trend analysis

## Quick Start

1. Copy this skill folder to your workspace under `.github/skills/`
2. Reference in agent files: `skills: [sonarqube-dashboard-builder-skill]`
3. The skill activates automatically when the agent is invoked

## Structure

```text
sonarqube-dashboard-builder-skill/
  SKILL.md    # Skill definition with procedures and standards
  GUIDE.md    # This guide
```

## Companion Agent

This skill is designed to work with the `@sonarqube-dashboard-builder` agent from the Independent Agents catalogue.

## Key Capabilities

- Configure project dashboards with key metrics
- Create portfolio views for project groups
- Track quality trends over time
- Implement custom measures for visibility

## Technology Standards Applied

- **Dashboards**: Project and portfolio dashboard configuration
- **Portfolios**: Multi-project quality aggregation
- **Webhooks**: External notification and reporting
